summary: Completed comprehensive testing of P0 persistent login bug fix. All tests passed - staff login, admin login, and token persistence after page reload are working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Staff portal login pages correctly set 30-day staffLoginExpiry (StaffPortalLogin.jsx line 69, AdminPortalLogin.jsx line 43, DoctorPortalLogin.jsx line 71)
User data caching in localStorage (userInfo, patientInfo) is correctly implemented for offline/error resilience
safeParseJSON helper function properly handles JSON parsing errors (lines 31-37)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login persistence bug fix has been verified. Key changes: (1) AuthContext.js now only calls logout() on 401/403 errors, not on network errors, (2) User data is cached in localStorage (userInfo/patientInfo) for offline resilience, (3) Staff login pages set 30-day staffLoginExpiry. All staff portals (DiaGyn, Mango Labs, Orange Pharmacy, Admin) correctly store staffToken, staffInfo, and staffLoginExpiry in localStorage.

features_tested.feature: Staff login via DiaGyn portal persists after page reload
features_tested.details: staffToken, staffInfo, staffLoginExpiry all preserved after reload

features_tested.feature: Admin login persists after page reload
features_tested.details: Admin stays authenticated on /admin page after reload

features_tested.feature: localStorage staffToken, staffInfo, staffLoginExpiry are set after staff login
features_tested.details: All three keys correctly set with 30-day expiry
staffLoginExpiry is set to Date.now() + 30 days in milliseconds

features_tested.feature: /api/auth/me endpoint returns user data with valid token
features_tested.details: Returns user id, name, role, department correctly
Correctly rejects invalid tokens with 401 status
Same token can be validated multiple times successfully

features_tested.feature: Staff info structure has required fields for caching
features_tested.details: id, name, role, department, doctor_name (for doctors) all present

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: AuthContext.js was aggressively calling logout() on ANY API failure during token revalidation on mount, including network errors and server issues. This wiped all localStorage tokens even when the token was still valid.
fix_applied: AuthContext.js fetchUser() now only calls logout() on 401/403 (token explicitly invalid)
For network errors, user data is restored from localStorage cache (userInfo/patientInfo)
User state is immediately hydrated from localStorage cache on mount for instant session restore
Staff/Doctor/Admin portal logins now set 30-day staffLoginExpiry
rca_of_the_issue.verification: All tests pass - tokens persist after page reload, 30-day expiry is set, and user remains authenticated
